title: Now that I think about it, I have been in the "hospital" BUT for me it was a Chemistry LAB.
content: Basement: Inaccessible storage and unused rooms, potentially shady, but no alarms raised. Level 1: Classrooms where you would take Chem 1100 Level 2: Higher level classrooms and teaching labs Level 3: Normal laboratories and offices Level 4: Definitely creepy/illegal vibes. Catching views of some of the experiments, there are potentially nuclear isotopes, biological abominations, mysterious specimen tissue samples. It seems to break the discipline of chemistry and enter into biological type experiments. The laboratories in this level are centrally located with no exterior windows. There appear to be measures present to "lock down" the lab to some extent, and I get the feeling that I should not be on that level seeing the things I'm seeing. Workers in hasmat suits. Like i'm inside the CDC or resident evil or something. [It was JUST like this except it had a central bank of laboratories that did not have outside windows in addition to the outer bank that did have outside windows as you can see. ](https://preview.redd.it/p0cq5jld5pxc1.jpg?width=910&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=c7a2e842b2efbe708e48223665010a1a6077eeda) &#x200B; [This is the hallways that surround the central corridor on level 4. Like you are in a BSL-3 observation gallery. If you look in the windows on level 4, there is some shady stuff going on.](https://preview.redd.it/e6ab1xlq5pxc1.png?width=450&format=png&auto=webp&s=06b1080f25e2a8ad1d789b2aa683b9255a50d274)
